initialExam.title: Rajasthan Judicial Services Exam 2026
initialExam.description: Rajasthan Judicial Services exam for recruitment of Civil Judges and Judicial Magistrates in Rajasthan.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: Law, Hindi, English. Mains: Civil Law, Criminal Law, Evidence, Constitution, Local Laws.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Preliminary Exam → Mains Exam → Viva Voce → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Civil Judge / Judicial Magistrate in Rajasthan courts
initialExam.careerGrowth: Civil Judge → Additional DJ → District Judge → High Court Judge.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit hcraj.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government residence, Vehicle, Medical, Pension
